title: Observation Science Foundation for World / Reconfiguration
purpose: Make Book VII observation-science authority boundaries executable across World, Reconfiguration, Current Dossiers, Signals, provider data, RRE and runtime-position derivation.
corePrinciples: Reality is the final correction authority; models, evidence, reconstructions and projections remain revisable.
Trace is not automatically evidence; evidence is not automatically fact; signal is not automatically evidence.
Observation resolution, scale, window, sampling, baseline, error, missingness and uncertainty must remain inspectable.
A current provider payload is an observation source candidate, not a world verdict.
Derived runtime readout is not observed fact.
Projection is conditional and never a prediction or guaranteed future.
UNKNOWN is a governed output and must not be replaced by confident filler.
Historical precedent may constrain interpretation but never determine current state or future position.
Observation-threshold crossing remains human-governed and cannot be established by a single score, event, source, price move or model output.
branchingRule: TRACE may enter signal evaluation and/or evidence evaluation. SIGNAL and EVIDENCE are distinct lanes with separate authority. They may reference the same trace but never become interchangeable.
frontendRule: World customer surfaces consume projection-ready lightweight observation records only. Raw provider intake, raw snapshots, filings and large historical payloads remain backend evidence stores and must not be fetched directly by browser UI.
